endpoint_blind_statement: endpoint-blind protocol candidate fixed before endpoint score readout; the shape is selected from the predeclared Route B power-law cutoff family and not from ACT/Planck residuals or score outputs
known_limit_statement: when parent_tau_source_value -> 0, delta_PP_tau -> 0 under the linear_parent_source_v01 adapter
normalization_statement: dimensionless Route B parent-source convention; downstream delta_PP_tau = normalization * parent_tau_source_value
parameter_policy: parameters are convention-fixed for a first Tau-side Route B parent-source candidate; no residual tuning, no reduced chi2 tuning, no score tuning, and no verdict tuning are permitted
